name: Plan Is Not Run
statement: A prospective plan never proves that any activity executed or any entity was used or generated.

name: Logical Is Not Physical
statement: Logical dependency never identifies physical bytes or storage cuts without an explicit materialization link.

name: Runtime Is Occurrence Scoped
statement: Runtime lineage refers to exact runs/attempts and may not be generalized without an aggregation rule.

name: Derivation Is Not Execution
statement: Entity derivation and process execution are distinct relation families and neither is inferred from the other alone.

name: Assertion Boundary Preserved
statement: Issuer and assertion boundaries survive graph merge, inference, export and slicing.

name: Unknown Coverage Open
statement: Absence of an edge in an open-world graph never proves absence of dependency.

name: Digest Is Not Truth
statement: A matching digest establishes representation integrity under its scope, not truth, authority or semantic correctness.

name: Identity Is Scheme Scoped
statement: Identifier equality is evaluated only under its scheme, authority, version and time scope.

name: Signature Is Not Authority
statement: A valid signature proves control of verification material for a payload; issuer authority needs separate appraisal.

name: Attestation Is Not Appraisal
statement: An issuer attestation and an independent verifier appraisal remain distinct artifacts and roles.

name: Transparency Is Not Truth
statement: Transparency registration proves inclusion at a tree state, not correctness of the statement.

name: Evidence Needs Warrant
statement: Evidence supports a claim only through an explicit relevance/directness/warrant relation.

name: Defeaters Retained
statement: Counterevidence and unresolved defeaters are retained and surfaced in every reliance view.

name: Strength Is Multidimensional
statement: Authority, integrity, method, directness, relevance, corroboration and freshness are not collapsed by default.

name: Recording Time Is Not Validity
statement: Event, observation, recording, signing, registration, validity and appraisal times remain distinct.

name: Telemetry Is Not Evidence
statement: Telemetry becomes durable evidence only after explicit identity, integrity, retention, coverage and custody qualification.

name: Receipt Reports Failure
statement: A receipt represents failure, cancellation, partial or indeterminate outcomes directly; it never fabricates success.

name: Compiler Does Not Upgrade
statement: Compilation never strengthens semantics, assurance or evidence posture without a proven binding.

name: Audit Is Not Provenance
statement: Audit events/logs/trails and provenance assertions/graphs have different semantics and must be linked, not collapsed.

name: Log Is Not Evidence
statement: A log record is not evidentiary solely because it is structured, timestamped or retained.

name: Custody Continuity Explicit
statement: Every custody gap or seal/fixity failure remains explicit; later possession cannot silently repair it.

name: Reproduction Target Explicit
statement: Reproducibility is judged only against an explicit target and equivalence rule.

name: Lifecycle Actions Distinct
statement: Correction, deletion, retraction, recall and supersession have distinct effects and cannot substitute silently.

name: Redaction Is Not Deletion
statement: A disclosure redaction transforms a view and does not imply source deletion or nonexistence.

name: Missing Identity
statement: A subject, occurrence, issuer, artifact or scope lacks a resolvable identity.

name: Ambiguous Occurrence
statement: Type, plan, run, retry and event identities cannot be separated.

name: Missing Authority
statement: No scoped authority exists for assertion, appraisal, disclosure, correction, hold or deletion.

name: Invalid Integrity
statement: Digest, signature, manifest, transparency proof or fixity verification fails.

name: Unknown Integrity
statement: Required representation or verification material is missing.

name: Stale Status
statement: Credential, key, attestation, method or source status is too stale for the relying policy.

name: Time Collapse
statement: Event, observation, recording, signing, registration, validity or appraisal time would be silently conflated.

name: Lineage Layer Collapse
statement: Prospective/retrospective or logical/physical/runtime lineage would be silently substituted.

name: Audit Provenance Collapse
statement: An audit log/trail would be represented as a provenance graph or vice versa without typed mapping.

name: Log Evidence Upgrade
statement: A log or span lacks durable evidence qualification for the proposed reliance.

name: Assertion Appraisal Collapse
statement: Self-assertion/attestation would be presented as independent appraisal.

name: Digest Truth Upgrade
statement: Representation integrity would be presented as claim truth or semantic correctness.

name: Open World Absence
statement: Missing lineage/audit/evidence record would be used as proof of non-occurrence or independence.

name: Unknown Edge Semantics
statement: A source edge cannot be mapped to a canonical relation with sound direction and qualifiers.

name: Incomplete Custody
statement: Custody continuity, seal/fixity or preservation history has a material gap.

name: Unresolved Defeater
statement: A blocking rebutting or undercutting defeater remains unresolved.

name: Unsupported Degradation
statement: A binding would reduce lineage granularity, evidence strength or receipt durability without authorization.

name: Provider By Name
statement: A provider is selected by brand/name rather than a versioned qualified offer.

name: Partial Effect As Success
statement: Partial, cancelled or externally indeterminate effects would be reported as success.

name: Reproducibility Overclaim
statement: The claimed reproduction guarantee exceeds captured data, method, environment or equivalence evidence.

name: Lifecycle Substitution
statement: Correction, deletion, retraction, recall or supersession would be silently substituted.

name: Hold Erasure Conflict
statement: Retention/legal-hold and deletion/erasure authorities conflict without adjudication.

name: Overdisclosure
statement: Requested evidence exceeds authorized purpose, audience, jurisdiction or minimization scope.

name: Confirmed Impact From Path
statement: Graph reachability alone would be labeled confirmed business or safety impact.
